decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until a method statement for the provision of services and any other perforations to the fabric of the listed building has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Such a statement shall include, but is not limited to, the following:
?	Details on the protection of the proposed building and surrounding trees
?	Protection of critical materials and construction, such as the coffered ceiling in the anteroom to the former library and the 'carrel' furnishing to the attic storey which is to be retained. 
?	Details of minimal intervention, ie only that absolutely necessary for access, alterations and for the introduction of services.
-              Positions and materials for soil/vent pipes and other ventilation arrangements.
?	Commencement of a log book to be continued during work to create a permanent record of work to the buildings. 

These details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples and specifications for the introduction of materials and finishes, such as render, roof coverings, edge details and rainwater goods have been provided.  Trials, samples and specifications for the cleaning and pointing of existing brickwwork and details of the bricks, mortar and pointing style of proposed brickwork shall also be provided.  The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - Before the development is commenced details in relation to the impact on existing finishes and structures of introduced thermal and sound insulation to the external envelope, and to units' compartments and partion walls shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 6 - Details of doors and windows and other joinery glazing, repair and replacement and addtion are to be submitted to and aproved in writing by the Council prior to installation.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
